metadata.note: Command teardown of ./repoloop.sh — the top-level shim (three-line bash) and the runtime/scripts/repoloop.py factory it wraps. The shim's only jobs: set errexit, resolve REPOLOOP_ROOT, exec python3 on repoloop.py with --repo and $@ forwarded. All logic lives in repoloop.py: discover() enumerates the intro trilogy, every SKILL.md, every case-branch in art (via ART_SOURCES), every executable runtime/scripts/*.py and runtime/qc/*.py, plus command-setup and command-repoloop. merge_queue() marks items whose source_sha256 or feedback_sha256 changed as pending. build_one() snapshots the parent toolkit into workspaces/<slug>/toolkit/ via snapshot_toolkit(), writes a per-episode settings.json (worker_settings() — Read/Glob/Grep/Bash + writes only in workspace+reel; deny git push, gh, curl, wget, ssh; deny .env/.ssh/.aws/.config/gcloud reads), strips ANTHROPIC_* env vars in worker_environment(), spawns 'claude -p PROMPT' foreground in a new session group, and verify_film() reads the beat sheet + probes the MP4 to enforce the shape gates (>=8 beats, Kokoro am_onyx, ClaudeComposerAsk cold open, HesitantWriter beat 2, greeting 'your turn' penultimate, ffprobe dims match aspect, audio mean_volume > -40dB, matching VISUAL-REVIEW.json with the current run_id). Modes: default single-drain; --forever watch loop with 10-minute rescan; --dry prints inventory; --prepare writes briefs/EXAMPLE-SOURCES.json without invoking Claude; --once builds one; --status reads queue.json + worker.lock; --stop writes .repoloop/STOP; --start detaches a supervisor; --shorts-only runs the derivative cut-first queue against completed native portraits; --landscape-only skips vertical; --only <id> targets a single film. All demo output in demo/RUN-LOG.txt is verbatim from this workstation, captured against the live repository — the --status block literally shows this very reel building (id=command-repoloop). Playlist adaptation for @HumanitariansAI: composer folder chip reads @HumanitariansAI; outro card is the locked ClaudeTitleOutro with hardcoded @NikBearBrown handle per OUTRO-LOCK.md — flagged in README.md for the human reviewer before publication. No paid API, no upload, no network calls. episode.source_sha256 1cc0c69fd8f8be70b36fd23fa4066ea40c93875b08fa02a6daef2d2aa8982acc.

beats.narration_text: Watch the writer walk this back. Repoloop dot sh does not render films. It spawns workers. One Claude subprocess per film, one queue, one lock — the loop drains the pending list and stops only when told.

beats.role_note: VERDICT — the whole surface, in the order you touch it.
beats.narration_text: So — repoloop dot sh. A three-line shim over a serial film factory. Six moving parts, in the order you touch them: the shim, discover, merge queue, snapshot toolkit, sandboxed worker, verify film. No parallelism. No auto-publish. No A P I-key fallback. A stop file gracefully terminates. A worker lock forbids duplicates. Six things — nothing else.

props.artifactHeading: repoloop.sh — the whole surface, in the order you touch it
artifactLines: the shim — 3 bash lines; sets errexit, resolves REPOLOOP_ROOT, execs python3 runtime/scripts/repoloop.py --repo $ROOT $@.
discover() — inventory derived from the toolkit itself: intro trilogy + skills/*/SKILL.md + case-branches in art + runtime & qc executables.
merge_queue() — reconciles inventory with .repoloop/queue.json; source_sha256 or feedback_sha256 change ⇒ status=pending, old renders preserved.
snapshot_toolkit() — copies runtime + skills + brands + docs into workspaces/<slug>/toolkit/; baseline SHA-256 map; symlinks node_modules.
worker_settings() + spawn — sandboxed 'claude -p PROMPT'; ANTHROPIC_* stripped; deny git push/gh/curl/wget/ssh; writes only workspace + reel.
verify_film() — fail-closed shape + ffprobe + audio + AI visual-review gate; refusal is the whole reason the command exists. Never publishes.

props.segment: Read the repoloop queue — do NOT start the loop
props.command: From the brutalist.art toolkit root: (1) run ./repoloop.sh --dry and give me the count grouped by kind — onboarding, skill, command, utility. (2) run ./repoloop.sh --status and read out the pending count, the review_ready count, and any active run_id. (3) Explain in one line what would happen if I edited FEEDBACK.md inside an already-review_ready reel folder — walk the code in runtime/scripts/repoloop.py that decides. DO NOT run --once, --forever, --start, or --stop.
output: step 1 — --dry prints a numbered inventory grouped by [kind]
step 2 — --status returns a JSON block; running:true means a supervisor holds worker.lock
step 3 — merge_queue()'s feedback_sha256 check pushes an edited FEEDBACK.md back to status='pending'
